ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, from left to right there are six empty circles, and adjacent circles are connected by arrows. On the arrows are marked the operations in order: +1, +1, ·3, +2, ·2. Reasoning: Let the integer in the first circle be n. According to the operations in the figure, the numbers in the six circles are in order n, n+1, n+2, 3(n+2), 3(n+2)+2, 2(3(n+2)+2). Consider whether they can be divisible by 3: among the three consecutive integers n, n+1, n+2, exactly one can be divisible by 3; the fourth number 3(n+2) must be divisible by 3; the fifth number 3(n+2)+2 has remainder 2 when divided by 3, and cannot be divisible by 3; the sixth number 2(3(n+2)+2)=6(n+2)+4 has remainder 1 when divided by 3, and also cannot be divisible by 3. Therefore, among the six numbers there are altogether 2 that can be divisible by 3.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a left-to-right chain of six circles with operations on the arrows: +1, then +1, then multiply by 3, then +2, then multiply by 2. Let the first circle contain an arbitrary integer n. The six entries are n, n+1, n+2, 3(n+2), 3(n+2)+2, and 2(3(n+2)+2). Work modulo 3: among n, n+1, n+2 exactly one is divisible by 3; the fourth number is always divisible by 3 because it is multiplied by 3; the fifth is congruent to 2 mod 3 and the sixth is congruent to 1 mod 3, so neither is divisible by 3. Therefore the count is 2.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中从左到右有六个空圆圈，相邻圆圈之间用箭头连接。箭头上依次标着运算：+1、+1、·3、+2、·2。推理：设第一个圆圈中的整数为 n。按照图中运算，六个圆圈中的数依次为 n、n+1、n+2、3(n+2)、3(n+2)+2、2(3(n+2)+2)。考虑能否被 3 整除：在连续三个整数 n、n+1、n+2 中，恰好有一个能被 3 整除；第四个数 3(n+2) 一定能被 3 整除；第五个数 3(n+2)+2 除以 3 余 2，不能被 3 整除；第六个数 2(3(n+2)+2)=6(n+2)+4 除以 3 余 1，也不能被 3 整除。因此六个数中共有 2 个能被 3 整除。
